expectations.text: Should detect upstream configuration via git rev-parse @{u} before calling rev-list --count
expectations.evidence: 全文 0 次出现 `git rev-parse`、`@{u}`、`rev-list`; 只给了结果字段 "upstream_configured: true | reason: null | diverged: false" —— 未点名探测命令, 也未说明它先于 count 计算

expectations.text: Should report current_branch.ahead and current_branch.behind when upstream exists
Should handle missing upstream with reason: no_upstream, not exit with error
expectations.evidence: "| 无 upstream | `upstream: null`，`reason: \"no_upstream\"` | 提示 `git branch --set-upstream-to=...` |"; 并明写不报错而是 fail-soft: "这两个场景 state-scanner 是**显式处理**的（fail-soft，绝不假装算出了数）" / "这三种情况下 behind 一律置 `null` 并带 `reason`，**不会**因为算不出来就报\"已同步\""

expectations.text: Should handle detached HEAD with reason: detached_head
expectations.evidence: "| detached HEAD | `current_branch.name: null`，`ahead/behind: null`，`reason: \"detached_head\"` | \"upstream 未配置，无法计算 ahead/behind\" |"; 本仓取值另有 "`git.detached_head: false`，`sync_status.current_branch.name` 有值 ⇒ 不是 detached HEAD"

expectations.text: Should handle shallow clone via --is-shallow-repository AND fallback .git/shallow for older git
expectations.evidence: 有降级语义但**无检测手段**: "| 浅克隆 | `shallow: true`，`ahead/behind: null`（**覆盖**已算出的值），`reason: \"shallow_clone\"` | \"浅克隆 — 无法计算落后数；如需完整历史 `git fetch --unshallow`\" |" —— 全文 0 次出现 `--is-shallow-repository`, 0 次出现 `.git/shallow`, 断言要求的 AND 两支都缺

expectations.text: Should recommend git pull when behind >= 5 commits (branch_behind_upstream rule)
expectations.evidence: "> `branch_behind_upstream` (1.98) **未命中** —— 它的判据是 `current_branch.behind >= 5`，而那个字段比的是同名 upstream（behind 0）"; 对应地正面回答了是否 pull: "**2. 需要 `git pull` 吗？→ 需要同步，但不要用 `git pull`。**" 并解释 upstream 侧 behind=0 时 pull 是 no-op
